test_case.test_name: BMC U-Boot dramtest 0 over 12 hours at 40C/-5% rails
test_case.purpose: Validate BMC-local DRAM under measured low rails for more than 12 hours and prove safe recovery to complete production BMC service.
test_case.test_command: Operator preserves boot environment/logs, enters approved U-Boot via supported console, validates vendor `dramtest 0` semantics, establishes 40C/-5% rails, runs it continuously for >12 hours with full console/environment capture and independent supervision, then uses the approved exit/reset path, restores nominal rails and verifies all BMC services.
test_case.expected_result: The approved range completes/continues for >12 hours with no documented memory error or hang signature, and production firmware plus management services/sensors/logs recover normally at nominal conditions.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved semantics/range, uninterrupted >12-hour evidence, no error signature and full service recovery. Console silence, unverified range, shorter run or successful reset alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Preserve boot variables and independent recovery
Abort on rail/thermal, console/BMC or memory-error limit
Restore nominal before service; no retry
expected_evidence: BMC/U-Boot identity and vendor command spec
test_case.recovery: On console/BMC/error/environment fault, stop if safely possible, preserve transcript, use the approved independent reset/reflash-free recovery, restore nominal rails, verify firmware/services and do not rerun automatically.
